hotels.title: Grand Opening: Rainbow Bay Coastal Two- & Three-Bedroom Apartments with Rooftop Pool & Parking
hotels.description: Newly opened near serene Rainbow Bay, the refined Esprit Holidays haven places you moments from Coolangatta's coastal icons like Snapper Rocks, Greenmount Beach and Coolangatta Beach. Each apartment is both stylish and comfortable, with sleek relaxation spaces and dazzling vistas. Unwind in style at the sparkling rooftop pool with uninterrupted views of the Pacific Ocean, then find a moment of peace in the sauna or steam room. Downstairs, you’re close to the Rainbow Bay Surf Club for seafood and sea views, and a short stroll from Coolangatta’s cafés, boutiques and beachfront dining along Marine Parade. Kirra’s laid-back eateries and the surf breaks of Duranbah Beach are also within easy reach.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Beachfront Self-Contained Escape on Coolangatta Beach with Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Discover the allure of sunny Queensland with a stay along the beautiful Coolangatta Beach. Perfectly positioned on Marine Parade, this beachfront escape is a stone's throw from the world-renowned Snapper Rocks surf break and the vibrant Coolangatta dining precinct. With spacious self-contained studios and apartments, a heated swimming pool, tennis courts and a fully equipped gym, the retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation and activity.
